messages:
laura: Noticed a steady rise in failed gang schedules in us-west2 since 02:07 UTC. Headline: large inference gangs can't find NVLink neighbors, small pods getting packed into GPU racks. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/xyz/evictions
ben: pinging scheduler logs now. any recent cluster-label/instance-type changes in us-west2?
laura: we flipped rack-labeling to prefer `nvlink=true` for some N-type families yesterday to reduce inter-rack traffic. maybe labeling was too greedy.
ricardo: grep on scheduler events: `kubectl get events -n prod --field-selector involvedObject.kind=Pod | grep "failedScheduling" | tail`  lots of `TopologySpreadConstraint` and `Affinity` failures referencing nvlink.
ben: digging into node objects: some nodes have label `nvlink=present` but their instance type is N1 (no nvlink). appears the inventory script mis-tagged them during a flaky metadata call.
laura: ah. so scheduler thinks there are NVLink-capable neighbors and tries to place gang pods across them, but during runtime they lack NVLink and the pod sidecars fail healthchecks -> preempt cascade.
ricardo: quick mitigation: add a pod anti-affinity override to keep small non-gang pods off nvlink-labeled nodes. We can also remove the `nvlink` label from the mis-tagged nodes.
laura: please remove labels for suspicious nodes first; we don't want to trigger mass reschedules by touching many nodes simultaneously. target 3 nodes as test.
ben: running: `for n in gpu-node-{12,24,36}; do kubectl label node $n nvlink- --overwrite; done`
ops-bot: maintenance: label removal initiated by ben on nodes gpu-node-12,gpu-node-24,gpu-node-36.
ricardo: after unlabeling the three nodes, failed schedules dropped ~70% in the next 90s. good signal.
laura: follow-ups: 1) fix inventory agent to validate instance type before tagging (infra#812), 2) add e2e that simulates mismatch between label and hardware, 3) add alert `nvlink_label_mismatch > 0` when kube labels != cloud metadata, 4) temporary autoscaler rule: avoid scaling into nodes labeled nvlink unless instance-type matches.
ben: opened infra#812 with patch to query cloud metadata and a dry-run mode. also wip PR to add `label-validation` admission check.
laura: nice. also notify support for any customer jobs in the window. I'll draft short notes. :shipit:
